stations.title: Idris
stations.say: How do I get around in here?

stations.title: Top folder
stations.text: You can look from here, but not move yet.
stations.note: client proofs makes the shell complain.

captions: Back at Ashgrove, Idris needs to get around the folders, and into client proofs.
Today the shell stays in one folder, and the space in client proofs trips it up.
You move around with paths and get into client proofs, in three tasks.
The shell goes deep, climbs back out, and opens client proofs.
One map, many paths. Idris can now reach any folder from anywhere.
